name: theeram
description: Firestore security rules and their emulator test suite for Theeram.

scripts.test: npm run test:risk && npm run test:xss && npm run test:push && npm run test:account && npm run test:google && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:monitor && npm run test:rules && npm run test:monitor:emulator && npm run test:purge && npm run test:reconcile
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-theeram "node --test tests/vuln-demo.test.mjs tests/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:monitor:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-theeram "node --test tests/monitor-run.test.mjs tests/monitor-notify-emulator.test.mjs"
